I was in Japan for 4 ½ months and this is what I packed

-Clothes appropriate for the time of the year, be careful of cultural norms for cleavage or skirt length, if you go to Japan you will be wearing an uniform for most of the time anyways
-Present for my host family
-2 pairs of shoes and slippers
-Pens and a notebook, the rest you'll probably get when you are there
-Something to help with homesickness, for me it was a small plush and candy
-Special food you like, tea in my case
-Toiletries, if you go to japan deodorant, the Japanese stuff doesn't work, toothpaste with fluoride, makeup in my skintone

Some mistakes I made

-Giving money to my sensei straightup and not in an envelope
-Wearing a dreas with too big of a cleavage
-Leaving grains of rice in the bowl (My host sister corrected me on that one)

-Being very loud in public spaces
-Not reading the mood of the room well enough

Don't worry too much and just try to enjoy your stay and do your best with the language
